description: The dataset supplies plant-historian pressures, wellhead flows and consumer demand observations used to validate a natural-gas production-network model. It includes measured and predicted pressure and flow values. The provider is Rudzani Dzedzemane, University of Pretoria. Coverage: The study network contains wells, pipelines and choke valves. Its location, observation dates and measurement interval are not stated in the public description. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The provider page specifies CC-BY-4.0. The files were not downloaded. Limitations: The page establishes the deposit, not model accuracy or independent reuse. Data definitions and reproducibility require inspection beyond the public metadata. For simulation it supports comparison of gas-network model predictions with the supplied plant observations. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
